## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by refining SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK parameters to improve performance on J days while avoiding losses on loser days. The edge exists because the level break setup has a directional bias that can be captured with proper parameters, but the current refinement shows poor J-day capture relative to potential.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Volume multiplier > 1.1  
- Body size >= 0.02 cents  
- Minimum 2 stars (internal scoring)  
- Strike offset of 2 (OTM-2 put)  
- Proximity to level < 1.5 dollars  
- Require break above open (note: for put setup, this may be incongruent; requires validation)  

**Exit:**  
- Premium stop at -6% (catastrophe stop)  
- TP1 at 40% of premium (sell 2/3 of position)  
- Runner target at 300% of premium (effectively letting runner run)  
- Profit lock: not activated (threshold 0%)  
- Profit lock stop offset: 8% (unused due to zero threshold)
